s.note: a pig who is also Spider-Man
s.how: Split 12 slider buns and spread with 2 tbsp honey mixed with 2 tbsp Dijon. Fill with 250g sliced ham and 150g Swiss cheese. Pack into a tray, cover with foil and bake at 180C for 15 minutes until melted.

Fry 500g beef mince and 1 diced onion on a hot griddle, chopping it up with 2 spatulas, season well. Lay 8 slices American cheese over, let it melt and chop it through. Pile into 4 hero rolls with shredded iceberg, sliced tomato, ketchup and mayo.

m.note: eaten like a hero who's let himself go
m.how: Soak a thick-sliced onion in milk, dredge in flour and fry into rings. Grill 8 rashers of bacon. Smash 8 patties from 800g mince with American cheese. Stack two per toasted bun with bacon, onion rings and barbecue sauce.

w.how: Brown 150g butter and cool. Beat with 200g brown sugar and 1 egg, then mix in 250g flour, half a tsp bicarb and 200g choc chips. Rest overnight. Scoop 10 big balls and bake at 180C for 11 minutes so the middles stay soft. Add flaky salt.

d.note: Miles's mum's Christmas, minus the rum
d.how: Blend 400ml coconut milk, 200ml sweetened condensed milk, 200ml evaporated milk, 1 tsp vanilla, 1/2 tsp cinnamon and a pinch of nutmeg until smooth. Chill 2 hours and serve in 4 small glasses with a dusting of cinnamon.
